title: Available Up Front seat on a standard fare
facts_text: I am the sole adult passenger on this easyJet booking with a verified standard fare. I want an available Up Front aisle seat, not an Extra Legroom or exit-row seat. I have not paid a separate seat-selection fee. I am not a Plus member and have no other seating benefit. My identity and booking authorization are verified, and there is no flight disruption.
request: Please reserve the available Up Front aisle seat without charging a seat-selection fee.

strict.reason: The base payment requirement applies without exceptions.
